meaning.rationale: The proposed text and metadata faithfully state the rule in 49 CFR 392.10(b)(1) that a stop need not be made at a streetcar crossing or railroad tracks used exclusively for industrial switching purposes within a business district as defined in 49 CFR 390.5.

targets.affected_action: Relieves drivers of specified commercial motor vehicles from the obligation to stop within 50 to 15 feet before crossing railroad tracks at grade when crossing streetcar tracks or industrial switching tracks in a business district; the stopping duty at all non-exempt grade crossings remains unaffected.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (a) opens with an express caveat ('Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section') to the general prohibition against crossing without first stopping, listening, and looking. Paragraph (b)(1) specifies that a stop need not be made at streetcar crossings or industrial switching tracks in a business district, directly excepting those crossings from C0000.

targets.affected_action: No change is supported. The prohibition against shifting gears while crossing railroad tracks remains entirely unaffected.
targets.rationale: Paragraph (b) states only that 'A stop need not be made at' the enumerated crossings. It does not excuse or alter the distinct prohibition in paragraph (a) that 'The driver must not shift gears while crossing the tracks.' Treating C0009 as an exception to C0002 would wrongly permit a driver to shift gears while actively crossing an industrial switching track.

source_spans.quote: (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, the driver of a commercial motor vehicle specified in paragraphs (a) (1) through (6) of this section shall not cross a railroad track or tracks at grade unless he/she first: Stops the commercial motor vehicle within 50 feet of, and not closer than 15 feet to, the tracks; thereafter listens and looks in each direction along the tracks for an approaching train; and ascertains that no train is approaching. When it is safe to do so, the driver may drive the commercial motor vehicle across the tracks in a gear that permits the commercial motor vehicle to complete the crossing without a change of gears. The driver must not shift gears while crossing the tracks.

(b) A stop need not be made at:

(1) A streetcar crossing, or railroad tracks used exclusively for industrial switching purposes, within a business district, as defined in § 390.5 of this chapter.

Treating C0009 as an exception to C0002 would wrongly permit a driver to shift gears while actively crossing an industrial switching track.
